Package com.example.moogerscouncil

Class SecureMessage

java.lang.Object
com.example.moogerscouncil.SecureMessage
public class SecureMessage extends Object
Thread-keyed in-app message for secure pre-session and cross-session communication. Stored at messageThreads/{counselorId_studentId}/messages/{messageId}. The sessionDate / sessionTime fields drive date-divider grouping in the UI.

  • Constructor Details

    • SecureMessage

      public SecureMessage()
      Required empty constructor for Firestore.

    • SecureMessage

      public SecureMessage(String counselorId, String studentId, String senderId, String senderRole, String sessionDate, String sessionTime, String messageText)
      Creates a new outgoing message for a counselor-student thread.
      Parameters:
      counselorId - Firestore UID of the counselor.
      studentId - Firestore UID of the student.
      senderId - UID of the user sending this message.
      senderRole - UserRole.COUNSELOR or UserRole.STUDENT.
      sessionDate - The appointment date ("yyyy-MM-dd") this message belongs to.
      sessionTime - The appointment time ("HH:mm") this message belongs to.
      messageText - The message body.
